red_flags.description: 45 mil TPO proposed where RFP specifies 60 mil minimum. 45 mil is below industry standard for commercial low-slope (fixture 02 §1) and voids most NDL warranty programs at this tier.
red_flags.evidence: Bid 'Key Specifications': 'Membrane: 45 mil TPO, mechanically attached'; price breakdown line: 'TPO membrane (45 mil) $145,000'

red_flags.description: No cover board included over polyiso insulation. Missing cover board on commercial polyiso system under NDL warranty claim is a critical defect — puncture resistance, thermal bridging, and wind-uplift performance all compromised; voids manufacturer system warranties.
red_flags.citation: fixture 02 §4; RFP §2.1 ('1/4 inch gypsum or high-density polyiso cover board' required)
red_flags.evidence: Bid specifications and price breakdown list single-layer R-30 polyiso with no cover board line item; 'Insulation (R-30, single layer) $95,000'

red_flags.description: Ponding resolution refused. RFP §2.1 includes tapered insulation or additional drains in base scope; bid declines to address and offers tapered insulation only as an upgrade.

red_flags.evidence: Bid Additional Notes: 'our inspection did not confirm significant ponding. We recommend proceeding with standard installation and addressing any drainage issues if they persist after completion.'

red_flags.description: Warranty duration and type both below RFP requirement. RFP requires total_system_ndl, 20-year minimum; bid offers '15-year limited warranty' with no system-warranty document referenced and no NDL language.
red_flags.citation: fixture 02 §1, §4.5; RFP §3.1 and §9.6 (20-year manufacturer, NDL total-system, certification required)

red_flags.description: Contractor not certified by any named manufacturer. RFP mandates manufacturer certification at the warranty tier claimed; bid names no manufacturer and no certification program (GAF Master Elite / Soprema PAQ+S / Firestone Platinum / Sika — none claimed).
red_flags.evidence: No manufacturer name, no system name, no certified-installer program named anywhere in the bid.

extraction_notes: Manufacturer and system name for the TPO membrane are not stated anywhere in the bid — owner must require disclosure before any further evaluation.

No bid bond referenced; RFP does not require a bid bond (only post-award 50% performance + 50% L&M per RFP §9.2) so this is not a gate fail, but owner must confirm consent of surety before contract execution.

Warranty type ambiguous: bid says '15-year limited warranty' with a 'Sample 15-Year Warranty Documentation' attachment — owner must obtain the actual warranty form; type classified as 'unclear' for scoring purposes.
CGL completed-operations tail years and owner-as-additional-insured status not declared in bid text — owner must inspect the attached COI endorsement page before award.
Reference project contract values not stated — owner must obtain contract values to confirm comparable-reference test (0.5x–2x subject project value).
Addenda acknowledgment and non-collusion declaration not present in the submission text — owner must obtain signed copies before contract execution (prudent-evaluator tier; not disqualifying).
WSIB clearance date and good-standing text not quoted in the bid — owner must inspect the attached certificate and online-verify per fixture 04 §1.4 before contract execution.
No DSA plan despite project flag — owner should confirm whether Lakeside intends to subcontract the DSA or expects the owner to complete it pre-mobilization; scope impact unpriced in the bid.
Bid explicitly disputes the ponding noted in the RFP — owner should confirm whether the base scope requirement stands or whether an addendum modified it.

Compliance status: non_compliant on TECHNICAL grounds. Technical DQ basis: membrane_thickness (45 mil vs 60 mil), cover_board (absent), insulation_upgrade (single layer vs two layers), warranty_type (unclear vs total_system_ndl), warranty_duration (15 yrs vs 20 yrs), scope_compliance (ponding, weather protection, HVAC coordination, phasing all excluded). These gates cannot be cured by clarification without re-tender.
